## Important limitations
Sterling Commerce Solutions is an independent provider and is not affiliated with Google or Shopify. Google independently controls Merchant Center eligibility, verification, review and enforcement. No approval, reinstatement, ranking or search visibility is guaranteed. The agent search endpoint exposes public service descriptions only and does not accept customer submissions or access private records.
